items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: He knows me. He's like, now he called me first. He said, you think you're? I said, yeah. I said, where you going, Louis?

ctx.x: You mentioned you saw him once across the lake, you said just a few years ago.

Yeah, I see him. I thought he was dead or he quit playing something. He had a case. He knows me. He's like, now he called me first. He said, you think you're? I said, yeah. I said, where you going, Louis? He said, man, I come from playing back there. He said, where you going? I said, I'm going over there by the Tunk. He said, Tunk, what do you want to go play over there? I said, well, we can't see it all hot and cold out here. You go make up with it. We don't know. We play the solan. They might actually play.
